crew.overview: Sent into a drunken tailspin when his entire unit is killed by a gang of thrill-seeking punks, disgraced Hong Kong police inspector Wing needs help from his new rookie partner, with a troubled past of his own, to climb out of the bottle and track down the gang and its ruthless leader.
crew.title: New Police Story

crew.overview: As sadomasochistic yakuza enforcer Kakihara searches for his missing boss he comes across Ichi, a repressed and psychotic killer who may be able to inflict levels of pain that Kakihara has only dreamed of.
crew.title: Ichi the Killer

crew.overview: Humans built huge engines on the surface of the earth to find a new home. But the road to the universe is perilous. In order to save earth, young people once again have to step forward to start a race against time for life and death.
crew.title: The Wandering Earth II

details.biography: Albert Yeung is born in Hong Kong in 1943. His  His ancestral home is Chaozhou, Guangdong Province. Yang has been in business with his father since he was a child. In 1964, Yeung  opened the "Observatory Watch Shop" on Nathan Road, Kowloon through the 200,000 yuan lent by his father. Two years later, he obtained the agency rights of Rolex watches and Omega, and opened up the jewelry market in the same year. So far, it has developed into a diversified conglomerate—Emperor Group, whose businesses include real estate, finance, watches and jewelry, entertainment culture, hotels, digital media, and lifestyle, etc., and has expanded to mainland China, Macau, China, and many overseas countries and regions.
details.name: Albert Yeung
